romans-10-study-notes.overview: This study note examines the reasons for Israel's rejection and the resulting consequences, while also exploring the remedy for that rejection and the broader message shared with the Gentiles.

romans-12-study-notes.overview: This study note explores the practical application of Romans 12, focusing on dedication, the nature of the living sacrifice, and the required attitudes for relationships with others and enemies.

romans-08-study-notes.overview: This study note explores the four spiritual freedoms found in Romans 8, focusing heavily on the theme of freedom from discouragement amidst suffering. It details the groans of creation, believers, and the Holy Spirit, while emphasizing God's perfect plan and the assurance of future glory.
